data.title: bn-2rk: stabilize distinct-stream coalescing gate
data.description: For bn-2rk at commit 7031c4e: replace the host-load-sensitive 2x elapsed-time assertion with exact CommitterMetrics batch/event/group/fsync invariants; add a task rendezvous; preserve same-stream correctness, final-head checks, and the D7 <= N/2 group gate; update flat-owner docs and commit the 10 normal + 5 same-core contention evidence. No production API or hot-path changes. Validation: all 15 stability repetitions reported serial 16/16/16 and concurrent 16/1/1; same-stream race passed; workspace all-target check, fmt-check, and diff-check passed.

data.body: HIGH: The new <= N/2 assertion is still scheduler-sensitive. The Tokio barrier releases tasks before LogEngine::append_batch begins; owner.inflight is incremented only inside append_batch, after this rendezvous. The preceding serial phase also leaves FlatOwner.target at 1. Therefore the owner may receive one task, observe inflight == 0 after its send, and close after the fixed 200 us grace while released-but-not-yet-polled tasks remain outside engine accounting. Repeated preemption can produce more than 8 exact groups even with unchanged correct code. The 10 normal and 5 CPU-0 runs are useful evidence, but do not turn this into a structural invariant. Move the rendezvous inside the counted admission interval/use a deterministic owner harness, or move this convoy-quality threshold out of the routine correctness gate.

MEDIUM: The same-stream test still has no start rendezvous. Spawning 32 tasks usually creates overlap, but the assertion also passes if the executor polls the appends serially, so it does not independently prove the documented atomic behavior under an actual race. Reuse a barrier here so every contestant is ready before the Exact(0) submissions begin.

LOW: The committed report gives the normal command but not the exact CPU-0 contention command, trap, or post-run process-check output. I confirmed no matching busy-loop processes are live now, but the historical cleanup and five contention repetitions are not independently reproducible from this artifact. Record the exact shell invocation and cleanup check, as the fold-chain report does for its contention diagnosis.

MEDIUM: The metric deltas are exact after all awaited appends, but the <= K/2 grouping result is not an engine invariant; it is an observed scheduling/coalescing outcome. Until the gate uses a rendezvous inside owner admission, saying this test proves at-most-K/2 groups and that counters establish overlap without host scheduling sensitivity overstates what the test guarantees.

data.reason: The replacement removes elapsed-time noise, but the <= N/2 routine gate still races released tasks against FlatOwner early-close because the rendezvous is outside owner in-flight accounting and target remains 1. It can still fail under scheduler preemption without a code regression. Make convoy admission deterministic or move the scheduling-quality assertion out of the correctness gate; also strengthen the same-stream rendezvous and evidence/docs as noted.

data.body: Addressed in 0ed7fe60. The Exact(0) test now uses an N+1 Tokio barrier; every spawned contender reaches the pre-submit boundary and the test task releases them together before awaiting results. The focused 32-task race passes.

Redesigned in 0ed7fe60 rather than defending the threshold. The scheduler-sensitive integration case and both groups<batches and groups<=N/2 assertions are gone. A private cfg(test)-only gate now records each intent after tx.send owns it and before its in-flight guard drops; the owner parks after its first receive and before gather until all 16 are admitted. The structural unit regression therefore requires exact serial 16/16/16 and one admitted cohort 16/1/1. It passed 3 debug plus 3 release runs. An incomplete-generation test also proves RAII guard drop unblocks the append and owner shutdown in both profiles. cargo check -p mess-store --release passes with all hook types, fields, wiring, and calls compiled out.

Addressed in 0ed7fe60. The guide now describes the post-admission cfg(test) structural capability proof and explicitly says arbitrary production scheduling has no at-most-K/2 or even fixed grouping guarantee. It calls production coalescing quality empirical and directs users to exact metrics for tuning.

Addressed in 0ed7fe60. The report retains and relabels all 15 prior passes as pre-review empirical evidence, and now includes the exact five-run CPU0 taskset command. Its EXIT/INT/TERM handling kills and waits every recorded busy-loop PID, then verifies each with kill -0 and fails if any remains.
Verified at 0ed7fe60: the N+1 Tokio barrier makes every contender reach the pre-submit rendezvous before release, so the Exact(0) assertion exercises an actual same-stream race. Resolved.

Verified at 0ed7fe60: the scheduler-sensitive integration threshold is removed. The private cfg(test) gate counts only after tx.send transfers ownership and before InFlightGuard drops; the owner waits after first receive and before gather. With N=16 below the bounded channel/group caps, all 16 intents are owner-visible before gather, making serial 16/16/16 and cohort 16/1/1 structural. The RAII incomplete-generation test covers append and shutdown unblocking, and static inspection confirms every type, field, initializer, and call is cfg(test). Resolved.

Verified at 0ed7fe60: the guide now limits the exact 16/1/1 claim to the post-admission structural test, explicitly rejects a fixed production grouping ratio, and describes production coalescing as scheduling/workload-dependent empirical quality. Resolved.

Verified at 0ed7fe60: the report includes the exact CPU-0 taskset loop, five invocations, EXIT/INT/TERM cleanup, kill/wait reaping, and post-cleanup kill -0 verification; it also distinguishes the older 15 empirical runs from the structural gate and records 3 debug plus 3 release exact 16/16/16 vs 16/1/1 results. Resolved.

data.reason: Reproduction and cleanup evidence recorded at 0ed7fe60

LGTM on static re-review of exact redesign HEAD 0ed7fe60a4bfccc697e8e09e8d1b85f8c01fc395. All four prior findings are resolved. The test-only gate is entirely cfg(test), admission is recorded only after channel ownership and before InFlightGuard drop, the owner parks after first receive before gather, and RAII disarm notifies the parked owner so incomplete generations cannot wedge append or shutdown. The private structural regression proves exact serial 16/16/16 vs cohort 16/1/1; same-stream rendezvous, docs, reproducible contention cleanup, and recorded 3 debug + 3 release evidence are consistent. No release API/state/hot-path hook and no remaining findings.
